behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A person can search private conversation text locally, see useful previews, and navigate to the matching message without sending the transcript to a provider.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/semantic-search.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/workspace-file-search.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Transcript search remains local and encrypted/indexed without provider egress.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Imported memories and sessions must remain subject to the same local search boundary.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Supported on the Kestrel desktop profile; no server-side transcript search is claimed.
behaviors.rationale: Existing encrypted local search and desktop navigation provide executable evidence for this exact outcome.
behaviors.notes: This is behavior-level evidence, not the broad memory.session-search family label.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Conversation search remains available after restart while private, incognito, and forgotten records stay outside the searchable result set.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/database/src/index.test.ts packages/encryption/src/index.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/semantic-search.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Restart recovery cannot turn encrypted or forgotten private state into provider-visible context.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Migration writes must use Kestrel persistence and retention semantics rather than importing a foreign index.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Supported in the local Kestrel database; remote supervision receives bounded redacted reads only.
behaviors.rationale: Database, encryption, and semantic-search tests cover persistence and local privacy boundaries.
behaviors.notes: Long-session performance remains bounded by the existing paging/index implementations.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Projects, session identity, grouping, and the selected conversation survive a normal restart without losing the browser return path.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/projects.test.ts packages/database/src/index.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Session organization is metadata-only and does not broaden tool or provider authority.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Imported sessions are explicitly placed in Kestrel projects and do not silently replace existing chats.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Supported in the desktop app; no claim is made for a native mobile client.
behaviors.rationale: The project grouping renderer and durable database tests exercise the user-visible organization path.
behaviors.notes: The family catalog remains broader than this exact restart behavior.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: One durable task state distinguishes active work, approval waiting, interruption, recovery, completion, failure, cancellation, and uncertainty across reload boundaries.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/runtime.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/agent-run-completion.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-session-state.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-evidence.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Stopped or uncertain work is not represented as a verified external success.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Migration cannot import active authority or revive a foreign in-flight task.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Durable state is local to the Kestrel profile; remote views are bounded supervision surfaces.
behaviors.rationale: Runtime, completion, and renderer evidence tests cover truthful state transitions and reload presentation.
behaviors.notes: Streaming transport is separate from the durable state record.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Delegated work remains associated with its parent task and summarizes progress and edits without exposing secret payloads.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/orchestration.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/action-receipts.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-evidence.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Activity summaries and receipts are value-bounded and do not carry credentials into model or renderer state.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Only supported static data is migratable; active child workers are not copied.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Parallel work is bounded by the local runtime and configured worker placement.
behaviors.rationale: Orchestration and receipt tests cover parent/child ownership and redacted evidence.
behaviors.notes: This entry does not treat a generic multi-agent family mapping as proof.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A task can expose a structured choice or multi-choice question with explanation, free-text alternative, explicit Skip, accessible controls, timeout, and cancellation.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-evidence.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: No rich question authority is claimed; normal chat input and approvals remain separate.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Foreign pending questions are not imported or replayed.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The current register records this as a known product gap rather than a platform limitation.
behaviors.rationale: The existing runtime evidence surface verifies waiting and approval states but does not prove rich structured-question controls; leaving this explicitly unresolved avoids a false parity claim.
behaviors.notes: P2 by the frozen backlog so the bounded truth-system pass does not add a new interaction subsystem.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: An answer to a task question cannot authorize a consequential action unless the separate approval contract grants that authority, and stale or cancelled work cannot consume it.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/runtime.test.ts packages/policy-engine/src/policy.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Kestrel keeps question-like human input from becoming an implicit mutation grant.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Pending authority from another product is discarded rather than migrated.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The safer boundary applies to desktop, CLI, and ACP runtime entry points.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel intentionally separates human input from one-time or recurring approval; approval and stale-run tests prove that boundary.
behaviors.notes: This is a safer product difference, not a claim of rich OpenClaw-style question controls.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: An interactive session widget runs with an opaque origin, no default network or credential access, and explicit grants for each allowed action and origin.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/mac-widgets.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/renderer-security.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/extensions/extensions.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Widget code cannot access Electron, the parent DOM, files, browser profiles, secrets, or unrestricted network by default.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Widget grants and executable widget state are not imported from OpenClaw.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Widgets are supported in the Kestrel desktop surface; arbitrary remote widget hosts remain outside the default trust boundary.
behaviors.rationale: Existing renderer-security, macOS widget, and extension tests cover the opaque-origin and grant boundary.
behaviors.notes: The exact action and origin grant is narrower than a broad dashboard capability label.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A person can pin or unpin a widget on the relevant task surface, see its provenance, and export a rendered view without granting it extra authority.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/browser/new-tab-widgets.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/mac-widgets.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Pinning and export are presentation operations and do not expand widget grants.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Pinned views are Kestrel-owned presentation state, not imported executable content.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Export uses the supported desktop renderer/native widget path; no cloud dashboard export is claimed.
behaviors.rationale: The renderer widget model and native widget tests prove the bounded presentation path.
behaviors.notes: The verifier checks evidence paths; UI capture remains a separate visual/manual gate.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A task can request a missing credential through a masked protected field that identifies the task and destination while keeping the value out of chat, receipts, logs, and renderer state.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/credential-broker.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/secure-storage-policy.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/renderer-security.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: The protected field is write-only and renderer/model payloads contain only safe request metadata.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Credential values and provider caches are excluded from every migration path.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Protected storage and native fields are implemented for the supported macOS desktop target.
behaviors.rationale: Credential-broker and secure-storage tests exercise metadata-only requests and value-free persistence.
behaviors.notes: Provider entitlement and successful completion remain separate from credential request readiness.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Protected credential substitution is restricted to approved destination hosts and ends when the owning run ends or loses authority.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/credential-broker.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/external-secret-manager.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/providers/http.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: The secret is never exposed to model context, renderer state, diagnostics, screenshots, or action receipts.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Foreign egress configuration and secret references are review-only and never activated on import.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Protected egress is available only through Kestrel-approved provider and extension routes.
behaviors.rationale: Credential broker, external secret, and HTTP provider tests cover allowlisted destinations and cleanup.
behaviors.notes: An authenticated catalog probe is not treated as proof of a generated response.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A recurring grant is bound to the exact tool, normalized operation, destination, identity, workspace, resource scope, schedule, and expiry rather than to a broad capability name.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/runtime.test.ts packages/policy-engine/src/policy.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/action-receipts.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Meaningful recipient, content, account, workspace, plugin, or executable changes cannot reuse a stale grant.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Approval rules are not copied from OpenClaw; imported settings require Kestrel policy review.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Exact grants apply across desktop, CLI, and supported protocol entry points.
behaviors.rationale: Runtime, policy, and receipt tests exercise one-time and persistent approval scope plus mutation evidence.
behaviors.notes: The user can inspect and revoke durable approval rules through existing Settings surfaces.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A denied or revoked consequential request is closed and cannot be silently retried as if its old approval were still pending; accepted mutations produce normal action receipts.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/runtime.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-evidence.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Kestrel prefers a closed denial and explicit fresh retry over automatic replay of a consequential action.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Pending or denied approval state from another product is never revived by import.
behaviors.platformBoundary: This safety boundary is part of the core runtime and is not delegated to a channel adapter.
behaviors.rationale: Closed denial, invalidated pending work, and action-receipt tests demonstrate the safer approval lifecycle.
behaviors.notes: This deliberate conservatism is not a missing automatic-permission feature.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Supported image, audio, video, and document artifacts retain bounded provenance and remain usable through response handling, reload, and session resume.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/media-artifacts.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/media-providers.test.ts packages/database/src/index.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Attachment paths are contained and bounded; media is not silently sent to unsupported providers.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Foreign media bytes and paths are not copied without an explicit supported import path.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Provider preparation is capability-gated; unsupported media remains visibly unavailable rather than guessed.
behaviors.rationale: Artifact, provider, and persistence tests cover supported media lifecycles and bounded preparation.
behaviors.notes: Live provider completion is separately entitlement- and route-dependent.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Failed or missing media preparation remains visibly failed or uncertain, with provenance and generated-media disclosure preserved; internal transport markers do not appear as chat text.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/media-artifacts.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/tool-result-guardrails.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-evidence.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Untrusted or missing artifacts cannot become a false verified completion or leak internal paths.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Invalid source media is skipped with a reason rather than imported as a successful attachment.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Truthful artifact state is shared across supported desktop and remote read surfaces.
behaviors.rationale: Artifact and tool-result guardrail tests cover bounded paths, redaction, and uncertain outcomes.
behaviors.notes: A real provider route is not simulated by these deterministic tests.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Private memory recall is local by default, provenance-backed, sensitivity-aware, explainable, correctable, forgettable, and excluded from unrelated group or channel context.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/memory.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/user-model.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/context-resolver.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Sensitive personal context stays encrypted and outside prompts until policy and context scope allow it.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Imported memory is normalized and reviewable; foreign private context is not silently widened to channels.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Local Kestrel memory is authoritative; optional remote memory services are disclosure-gated and untrusted.
behaviors.rationale: Memory, user-model, and context-resolver tests cover provenance, correction, sensitivity, and context filtering.
behaviors.notes: The safer local-first behavior is intentionally stricter than automatic ambient recall.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Background consolidation and generated skills are opt-in or staged for review, content-light in the diary, reversible, provenance-backed, and never silently overwrite user-authored skills.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/dreaming.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/memory.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/extensions/plugin-installer.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Low-confidence or sensitive content cannot silently become durable authority or executable behavior.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Imported skills remain reviewable and source-backed; generated content cannot overwrite user-authored files.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Consolidation is local and off by default; no vendor-hosted learning claim is made.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel deliberately requires review where an automatic reference default could promote private or low-quality content; dreaming and skill tests prove the gate.
behaviors.notes: This is a safer difference and not a claim that every automatic OpenClaw learning behavior is bundled.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Automatic routing remains the normal path while long-context opt-in, runtime input budget, model allowlists, model aliases, credential profiles, and per-agent scope remain distinct and fail closed on mismatch.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/model-orchestration.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/configuration.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/providers/providers.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: A model identifier cannot select an unrelated credential profile or silently widen context exposure.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Only bounded non-secret model and policy translations are imported; provider credentials remain protected and separate.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Supported providers are capability- and entitlement-gated; provider-specific unsupported settings fail closed.
behaviors.rationale: Routing, configuration, and provider catalog tests cover policy separation and fallback decisions.
behaviors.notes: Catalog presence and reachability are not treated as generation success.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Compaction preserves active-turn instructions, tool continuity, checkpoints, relevant attachments or omissions, branch identity, and usage accounting.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/context-compactor.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/runtime.test.ts packages/database/src/index.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Compaction must not turn omitted sensitive content into new model context or lose approval provenance.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Foreign compaction markers are not trusted as Kestrel checkpoints.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Compaction is local to the Kestrel runtime and backed by encrypted database state.
behaviors.rationale: Compactor, runtime, and database tests cover continuity and usage persistence.
behaviors.notes: A long-context provider capacity is distinct from Kestrel's runtime input budget.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Cancel, stop, uncertain tool outcomes, and explicit retry produce truthful interrupted records; late recovery hooks cannot duplicate replies or replay side effects automatically.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/runtime.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/action-receipts.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Unknown effects remain uncertain and cannot be silently retried after authority or process loss.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Interrupted foreign runs are not reanimated by migration.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The stop and uncertainty contract applies to local runtime calls and supported remote supervision.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel chooses explicit retry through normal approvals instead of automatic replay; runtime and receipt tests prove that safer contract.
behaviors.notes: This preserves the user's ability to inspect evidence before taking another action.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Recurring work is explicit, inspectable, cancellable, bounded, and routed only to its explicit or resolvable owner conversation rather than an unrelated prior destination.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/orchestration.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/usage-governor.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/event-applications.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Ambient work cannot message an unrelated group or exceed bounded resource and permission scope.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Foreign cron payloads are inventoried for manual recreation, not imported or activated.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Scheduling is local and owner-bound; vendor-specific delivery is separately gated.
behaviors.rationale: Scheduler, event, and governor tests cover ownership, bounded execution, and quiet failure for unresolved destinations.
behaviors.notes: Recurring permission scope is separately registered under exact approvals.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Parallel workers retain parent ownership, bounded concurrency, cancellation, completion delivery, and failure privacy; follow-up suggestions never silently start work.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/orchestration.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/usage-governor.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/runtime-session-state.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Capacity and cancellation limits prevent an unbounded worker fan-out from bypassing approvals or privacy scope.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Active worker placement and authority are not part of a static import plan.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Worker placement is explicit; unsupported remote placement must not silently fall back to local execution.
behaviors.rationale: Orchestration and governor tests cover ownership and resource limits while renderer state keeps suggestions inert.
behaviors.notes: Machine capacity defaults remain operator-overridable within bounded limits.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: A paired remote surface can supervise the exact host, session, workspace, job, approval, attachment, and reconnect state with authenticated bootstrap and revocation.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/native-nodes.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/remote.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/remote-http.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/gateway-networking.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Bearer tokens are scoped and revocable; remote reads and actions remain authenticated and bounded.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Device identity and live pairing authority are never copied from OpenClaw.
behaviors.platformBoundary: This is a tested paired-node/web extension contract, not a bundled native mobile app or vendor relay.
behaviors.rationale: Native-node, remote, HTTP, and gateway tests exercise identity, placement, reconnect, and revocation through the supported contract.
behaviors.notes: Optional operator-supplied nodes remain separately deployed and trusted.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Kestrel provides responsive authenticated supervision and a paired-node contract, but does not claim to ship an iOS or Android application.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/native-nodes.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/remote-web.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: The boundary prevents a responsive web surface from being misrepresented as a native application with unverified device authority.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Native app state and mobile credentials are not migratable because Kestrel does not ship those clients.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Native iOS and Android artifacts are outside the supported Kestrel macOS single-user product scope.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel intentionally ships a direct-download Apple Silicon desktop app plus a tested remote contract, not native mobile binaries.
behaviors.notes: This is a truthful platform boundary, not a hidden fallback.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Before install or enablement, the person can inspect plugin publisher, source, version, artifact identity, declared capabilities, and trust status; arbitrary executable sources require elevated consent.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/extensions/plugin-installer.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/extensions/extensions.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/plugin-trust-store.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Capabilities are declared and consented to for the exact trusted artifact; undeclared authority is denied.
behaviors.migrationImplications: OpenClaw plugin packages and executable paths remain review-only inventory, never automatic imports.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The extension contract supports signed Kestrel plugins; it does not claim every OpenClaw vendor plugin is bundled.
behaviors.rationale: Installer, extension, and trust-store tests prove exact artifact consent and the signed extension boundary.
behaviors.notes: Security-audit metadata is shown when available and is not fabricated when absent.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Declining a plugin update preserves the previous working artifact, and uninstall removes only exact managed paths while leaving unrelated parent, child, and prefix paths intact.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/extensions/plugin-installer.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/plugin-trust-store.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/startup-recovery.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Artifact identity and path containment prevent update decline, uninstall, or startup recovery from deleting or enabling unrelated code.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Plugin files and executable paths are excluded from cross-product migration.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Managed plugin paths are Kestrel-owned; arbitrary user-managed installations are not silently removed.
behaviors.rationale: Plugin installer, trust-store, and startup recovery tests cover update rollback and exact path handling.
behaviors.notes: Denied approval remains closed and requires an explicit new decision.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: OpenClaw migration begins with a read-only, sanitized preview bound to the chosen source, target window, and expiring plan; raw settings, credentials, executable plugins, bindings, and scheduled payloads stay out.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/administration.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/migration-plan-store.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Filesystem-bearing plans remain in trusted code and secret-bearing input cannot reach the renderer or model.
behaviors.migrationImplications: The preview is the required human review boundary; source files remain untouched.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The bounded importer supports synthetic and user-selected local source directories; it does not infer authority from discovery.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel deliberately imports only supported, sanitized classes rather than copying OpenClaw authority; administration and plan-store tests prove the boundary.
behaviors.notes: Operator approval is required before apply.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Applying an approved migration revalidates source hashes, defaults to no overwrite, creates recoverable Kestrel-side state, verifies the result, and preserves the source installation.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/administration.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/migration-plan-store.test.ts packages/database/src/index.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Containment, size, binary, checksum, expiry, one-time, and no-overwrite checks fail closed before writes.
behaviors.migrationImplications: The synthetic v2026.8.1-shaped fixture is the repeatable evidence path; a real user profile is never required for tests.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Migration operates on explicit local directories and Kestrel-owned target state.
behaviors.rationale: Existing hardened migration tests prove source preservation, checksum revalidation, and bounded target writes.
behaviors.notes: Unsupported consequential items are recorded with reasons for manual recreation.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Migration previews enumerate unsupported cron, channel/ACP binding, plugin, and plugin-path items with human-readable reasons instead of silently dropping or activating them.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/administration.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Review-only inventory prevents hidden authority, executable paths, scheduled payloads, and credentials from crossing products.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Every skipped consequential class retains an explanation for safe manual recreation.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The importer does not promise configuration compatibility with OpenClaw or other products.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel intentionally surfaces unsupported items instead of making a shallow compatibility claim; administration tests cover inventory counts and reasons.
behaviors.notes: This is a safer migration difference.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Backups are no-overwrite, hash-verified, versioned, and restorable only through a fresh staging boundary that rejects corruption or newer schemas without deleting user data.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/database/src/index.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/startup-recovery.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Backup and restore paths preserve encryption and refuse unsafe downgrade or overwrite behavior.
behaviors.migrationImplications: A recoverable Kestrel backup precedes approved imports; source product files are not the backup target.
behaviors.platformBoundary: The local snapshot and staging workflow is supported on macOS; public cloud backup hosting is not claimed.
behaviors.rationale: Database and startup-recovery tests prove schema and recovery boundaries; the desktop readiness script is a separate live harness.
behaviors.notes: The baseline readiness harness hung before producing evidence and remains separately reported.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Diagnostics are sanitized by default, and readiness/update checks identify the loaded build and reject old, unverifiable, dirty, or failed-rollback binaries as healthy.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/diagnostic-report.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/update-channel.test.ts scripts/release-distribution-verifier.test.mjs
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Diagnostics and release metadata exclude secrets, private content, and protected environment values.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Migration failures can be triaged without exporting source credentials or raw settings.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Public signing, notarization, and update hosting remain operator-owned release gates.
behaviors.rationale: Diagnostic and update tests cover sanitation and identity; distribution verification covers public-release assertions separately.
behaviors.notes: A development package is not presented as a notarized public release.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Supported channel and webhook integrations use authenticated, approval-aware delivery with bounded progress/reaction behavior; unsupported vendor-specific adapters remain explicit extension contracts.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/channels.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/remote-http.test.ts packages/shared-types/src/communication.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Inbound and outbound channel content remains authenticated, approval-gated, and value-bounded.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Channel bindings and tokens are inventoried but not imported or activated.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Native bundled adapters and the tested extension contract are distinct from a claim that every OpenClaw channel is bundled.
behaviors.rationale: Channel and remote HTTP tests prove the supported adapter and extension boundaries without adding shallow vendor integrations.
behaviors.notes: Gmail, Slack, Discord, Teams, and webhooks retain their existing provider-specific gates.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Browser tasks use isolated state, visible approvals, provenance, read-back verification, and bounded recovery; unknown or possibly-started mutations stop rather than replay automatically.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/agent-core/src/browser-recovery.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/browser-automation.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/action-receipts.test.ts apps/desktop/src/main/user-browser-service.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Browser cookies, private partitions, and uncertain external effects are protected by explicit trust and recovery boundaries.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Browser profiles and cookies are never copied from OpenClaw or another agent.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Browser-plus-agent integration is a Kestrel desktop capability; unsupported platform automation denies closed.
behaviors.rationale: Kestrel intentionally stops on unknown effects instead of trying to match automatic replay; recovery, automation, receipt, and browser-service tests prove that safer contract.
behaviors.notes: A read-only observation may be retried only within the bounded recovery policy.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Onboarding exposes protected setup choices, verifies a real supported route before trust, and reports configured, reachable, and fully verified as different states without asking for secrets in chat.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/setup-onboarding.test.ts packages/agent-core/src/providers/providers.test.ts apps/desktop/src/renderer/first-task.test.ts
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: Keys remain in protected fields and vendor OAuth stays in provider-owned surfaces.
behaviors.migrationImplications: Existing profiles prompt for explicit transfer or fresh start and are never silently merged.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Setup verification is for supported local/cloud provider routes and local Ollama where available; real entitlement remains external.
behaviors.rationale: Onboarding, first-task, and provider tests cover the setup authority and route-status distinctions.
behaviors.notes: A lightweight catalog or reachability probe is not called a full model completion.

behaviors.userVisibleBehavior: Kestrel's Apple Silicon development package and its public signed/notarized release are disclosed as different artifacts; public distribution is healthy only after operator-owned signing, notarization, and update-feed evidence exists.
behaviors.verificationCommand: corepack pnpm exec vitest run scripts/release-distribution-verifier.test.mjs scripts/macos-architecture-audit.test.mjs
behaviors.securityPrivacyImplications: A development identity or unsigned artifact must not be presented as a stable public release with trusted macOS permissions.
behaviors.migrationImplications: No migration data is involved; package identity remains separate from profile data.
behaviors.platformBoundary: Apple Developer ID credentials, notarization, external OAuth verification, and production update hosting require operator-owned inputs.
behaviors.rationale: The repository contains the release checks, but external credentials and published artifacts were not available in this pass; the gate is explicitly operator-blocked rather than claimed complete.
behaviors.notes: This is not a code-owned unresolved P0/P1 behavior.
